title: Theme resolution must use useResolvedTheme instead of raw option
answers: How to get the active dark or light theme in mitmweb components?
Why is CodeEditor or the web UI not switching to dark mode when web_theme is system?
How does mitmweb handle prefers-color-scheme OS dark theme?
body:
Components requiring the active theme in JavaScript must consume web/src/js/components/helpers/useTheme.ts:useResolvedTheme rather than inspecting state.options.web_theme directly.
Resolution is enforced in web/src/js/components/helpers/useTheme.ts:useResolvedTheme, which resolves the "system" preference to "dark" or "light" via window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)") and tracks dynamic OS changes.
If skipped, components like web/src/js/components/contentviews/CodeEditor.tsx:CodeEditor receive the raw "system" string, failing dark-mode checks and incorrectly rendering light styles for system-dark users.
web/src/js/components/helpers/ThemeManager.tsx:ThemeManager relies on this resolution to apply data-theme to document.documentElement.
applies: React components in web/ that need the active theme
says: The code editor stays in light mode even though the operating system uses dark mode.
Setting theme preference to system fails to automatically switch to dark theme.
Traffic body editor does not respect the dark theme setting chosen by the system.
The interface should automatically mirror operating system dark mode when set to system.
